purpose: Show a founder in seconds what changes for them, why Alliance AI Partners costs less, and get them to start an AI check-up.

seo.title: Alliance AI Partners | Put AI to work
seo.description: An embedded AI team in the Philippines for companies in the US, Australia and the UK. We build the AI tools and software you need, then help you grow. Published starting prices.

images.alt: Tangled ribbons straightening into one smooth ribbon.
images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background. On the left, a loose tangle of thin satin ribbons in Partner Navy and muted slate blue loops and knots over itself. Moving right, the strands are gathered and straightened into one smooth, wide satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan that flows out of frame at the upper right, the busy work of a week turned into one clear flow. A few small flat faceted paper leaves sit along its path. Generous calm Daylight space in the lower third. Portrait 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
